1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game targeting <canvas id="game">
2: 
3: (() => {
4: 
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800);
9:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600);
10: 
11:   // ---- Audio ----
12:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
13:   function beep(freq, duration) {
14:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
15:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
16:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
17:     osc.type = 'sine';
18:     osc.connect(gain);
19:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
20:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
21:     osc.start();
22:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
23:   }
24: 
25: 
26:   // ---- Game state ----
27:   const ship = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, r: 12, speed: 3, vx: 0, vy: 0, fuel: 100 };
28:   const asteroids = [];
29:   const orbs = [];
30:   let score = 0;
31:   let laserCooldown = 0;
32:   let gameOver = false;
33: 
34:   // ---- Input handling ----
35:   const keys = {};
36:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
37:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
38: 
39:   function spawnAsteroid() {
40:     const r = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
41:     const side = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'left' : 'right';
42:     const x = side === 'left' ? -r : W + r;
43:     const y = Math.random() * H;
44:     const vx = (Math.random() * 2 + 1) * (side === 'left' ? 1 : -1);
45:     const vy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
46:     asteroids.push({ x, y, r, vx, vy });
47:   }
48: 
49:   function spawnOrb() {
50:     const r = 8;
51:     const x = Math.random() * W;
52:     const y = Math.random() * H;
53:     orbs.push({ x, y, r, value: 5 });
54:   }
55: 
56:   // ---- Game loop ----
57:   function update(dt) {
58:     if (gameOver) return;
59: 
60:     // ship movement
61:     ship.vx = ship.vy = 0;
62:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.vy = -ship.speed;
63:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.vy = ship.speed;
64:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.vx = -ship.speed;
65:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.vx = ship.speed;
66:     if (ship.vx !== 0 || ship.vy !== 0) {
67:       beep(300, 0.04); // thrust sound
68:     }
69:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(W - ship.r, ship.x + ship.vx));
70:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.r, Math.min(H - ship.r, ship.y + ship.vy));
71: 
72:     // fuel consumption
73:     ship.fuel -= dt * 0.02; // drains over time
74:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
75: 
76:     // laser
77:     if (laserCooldown > 0) laserCooldown -= dt;
78:     if (keys[' '] && laserCooldown <= 0) {
79:       // simple laser: clear asteroids within 30px of ship
80:       for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
81:         const a = asteroids[i];
82:         const dx = a.x - ship.x;
83:         const dy = a.y - ship.y;
84:         if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < ship.r + 30) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
85:       }
86:       beep(600, 0.1); // laser sound
87:       laserCooldown = 0.5; // half‑second cooldown
88:     }
89: 
90:     // update asteroids
91:     for (const a of asteroids) {
92:       a.x += a.vx;
93:       a.y += a.vy;
94:     }
95:     // remove off‑screen asteroids
96:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
97:       const a = asteroids[i];
98:       if (a.x < -a.r || a.x > W + a.r || a.y < -a.r || a.y > H + a.r) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
99:     }
100: 
101:     // spawn logic
102:     if (Math.random() < dt * 0.5) spawnAsteroid(); // avg one every 2 seconds
103:     if (Math.random() < dt * 0.1) spawnOrb(); // occasional energy orb
104: 
105:     // check collisions with asteroids
106:     for (const a of asteroids) {
107:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
108:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
109:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < a.r + ship.r) { gameOver = true; break; }
110:     }
111: 
112:     // collect orbs
113:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
114:       const o = orbs[i];
115:       const d = Math.hypot(o.x - ship.x, o.y - ship.y);
116:       if (d < o.r + ship.r) {
117:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + o.value);
118:         score += o.value;
119:         beep(800, 0.08); // orb collection sound
120:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
121:       }
122:     }
123: 
124:     score += dt * 0.1; // survival points
125:   }
126: 
127:   function draw() {
128:     // background with starfield
129:     drawBackground();
130: 
131:     // ship – draw as a triangle with gradient
132:     const shipGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(ship.x, ship.y, ship.r * 0.2, ship.x, ship.y, ship.r);
133:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
134:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#004400');
135:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
136:     ctx.beginPath();
137:     const angle = Math.atan2(ship.vy || 0, ship.vx || 0);
138:     const tipX = ship.x + Math.cos(angle) * ship.r * 1.5;
139:     const tipY = ship.y + Math.sin(angle) * ship.r * 1.5;
140:     const leftX = ship.x + Math.cos(angle + Math.PI * 0.75) * ship.r;
141:     const leftY = ship.y + Math.sin(angle + Math.PI * 0.75) * ship.r;
142:     const rightX = ship.x + Math.cos(angle - Math.PI * 0.75) * ship.r;
143:     const rightY = ship.y + Math.sin(angle - Math.PI * 0.75) * ship.r;
144:     ctx.moveTo(tipX, tipY);
145:     ctx.lineTo(leftX, leftY);
146:     ctx.lineTo(rightX, rightY);
147:     ctx.closePath();
148:     ctx.fill();
149: 
150:     // asteroids – shaded circles
151:     for (const a of asteroids) {
152:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.3, a.x, a.y, a.r);
153:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
154:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
155:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
156:       ctx.beginPath();
157:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
158:       ctx.fill();
159:     }
160: 
161:     // orbs – glowing effect
162:     for (const o of orbs) {
163:       const orbGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 0, o.x, o.y, o.r * 2);
164:       orbGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,0,0.9)');
165:       orbGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,165,0,0)');
166:       ctx.fillStyle = orbGrad;
167:       ctx.beginPath();
168:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
169:       ctx.fill();
170:     }
171: 
172:     // UI
173:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
174:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
175:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}`, 10, 20);
176:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 40);
177:     if (gameOver) {
178:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
179:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
180:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
181:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
182:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
183:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2, H / 2);
184:     }
185:   }
186: 
187:   let last = performance.now();
188:   function loop(now) {
189:     const dt = (now - last) / 1000;
190:     last = now;
191:     update(dt);
192:     draw();
193:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
194:   }
195:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
196: })();
